posts.title: More Output, Less Progress?
posts.description: AI lets teams produce more output than ever, but more output also means more noise. Aligning people, not just agents, is now the bottleneck, and visualizations are still the best tool for it.

posts.title: Mais output, menos progresso?
posts.description: A IA permite que os times produzam mais output do que nunca, mas mais output também significa mais ruído. Alinhar pessoas, e não só agentes, virou o gargalo, e visualizações continuam sendo a melhor ferramenta para isso.

posts.title: Engineering Still Matters
posts.description: AI made building software easier, but not preparing for what comes next. Engineers still hold the quality bar, and keeping it is what makes software cheap to build, run, and evolve.
